options_evaluated: High-impact virgin polymers with thick walls
assessments.recommendation: High-impact virgin polymers with thick walls
assessments.rationale: High-impact virgin polymers with thick walls maximize the 'durability and reliability of the product and its components' (a) by offering superior resistance to stresses and ageing mechanisms over its technical lifetime (Page 79). This choice also minimizes the 'microplastic and nanoplastic release' (p) during the operational use phase (Page 80), which is more common in degraded or low-quality recycled plastics under stress.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing and End-of-Life stages, which prefer lightweighting to reduce raw material footprint and favor recycled or easily recyclable thin-walled materials.

assessments.rationale: Threaded fasteners with metal inserts directly support the 'ease of repair and maintenance' (b) by ensuring compatibility with commonly available tools (Page 79) and facilitating non-destructive disassembly. This prevents 'premature obsolescence' (Page 27) and reduces the 'amounts of waste generated' (r) (Page 80) by allowing targeted component replacement rather than discarding the entire unit.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, which prefers ultrasonic welding or adhesive bonding to minimize assembly time, part count, and production costs.

assessments.rationale: A brushless DC motor optimizes the 'use or consumption of energy... while in service' (g) (Page 79), significantly reducing the product's energy and carbon footprint (m) (Page 79, Page 3). Additionally, the absence of wearing carbon brushes enhances 'durability and reliability' (a) (Page 79) and eliminates carbon dust 'emissions to air' (q) (Page 80) during operation.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, which may prefer brushed AC or universal motors due to lower initial component costs and simpler electronic control requirements.

options_evaluated: Oversized passive heat sinks with dedicated ventilation ducts
Active cooling fan integrated on motor shaft
assessments.recommendation: Oversized passive heat sinks with dedicated ventilation ducts
assessments.rationale: Passive heat sinks with dedicated ducts improve 'durability and reliability' (a) (Page 79) by eliminating moving parts that can fail. This design prevents dust accumulation in the motor, maintaining optimal 'functional performance and conditions for use' (s) (Page 80) and reducing energy consumption (g) (Page 79) caused by thermal degradation or active fan power.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, which prefers active cooling to allow for a smaller, lighter, and more compact product housing, reducing material consumption.

options_evaluated: Semi-modular design with standard fasteners for wear-and-tear parts
Fully modular design with toolless swappable functional blocks
assessments.recommendation: Semi-modular design with standard fasteners for wear-and-tear parts
assessments.rationale: This architecture strikes the best balance for 'ease of repair and maintenance' (b) and the 'availability and accessibility of consumables and spare parts' (l) (Page 79). It allows users and professional repairers (Page 29) to easily replace high-wear parts (filters, brushes) using standard tools (Page 8), preventing 'premature obsolescence' (Page 27) and reducing 'waste generated' (r) (Page 80), while avoiding the reliability (a) risks of excessive connectors in fully modular designs.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, which favors a monolithic integrated design to simplify assembly processes, minimize material costs, and reduce the number of individual components.

options_evaluated: Mains-powered corded with automatic cord reel
Removable and standardized Li-ion battery pack
assessments.recommendation: Mains-powered corded with automatic cord reel
assessments.rationale: Mains-powered corded delivery eliminates battery degradation, thereby maximizing the 'durability and reliability' (a) and technical lifetime of the vacuum cleaner (Page 79). It avoids 'premature obsolescence' (Page 27) and the generation of hazardous battery waste (r) (Page 80), while ensuring consistent 'functional performance' (s) (Page 80) and avoiding energy losses associated with battery charging cycles (g) (Page 79).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Distribution and User-experience stages, which heavily favor cordless designs for portability, convenience, and ease of handling.
